label: verify-bm-testing-metrology

claims.claim: ISO 62 (technically equivalent to ASTM D570) is a mass method: dry at 50 C to constant mass, weigh to 0.1 mg within 1 min, 23.0 +/- 1.0 C water, time series, re-dry for extracted material, Fick fit for D and saturation; does not measure swelling strain.
claims.source_says: Reweigh the test specimens to the nearest 0,1 mg within 1 min of removing them from the water (mass m2). ... This test method and ISO 62 are technically equivalent when the test specimen described in 6.2 is used.
claims.note: All procedural details are in ISO 62 text (6.3, m3 re-dry, Fick fit) and ASTM D570 note; swelling is only listed as an effect, with no strain method.

claims.claim: 0.2 % of 40 mm is 80 um; 3-sigma discrimination needs ~5 um; caliper (25.4 um) fails; fixed-pose photo (15 um/px) can meet it on paper; micrometer +/-1 um used in PA6.6 study.
claims.source_says: Travers: Accuracy ±.001". PA6.6 paper: digital outside micrometer (Mitutoyo Digimatic, ± 1 μm). calc_out.json strain: signal_um 80, sigma_dL_for_6.7pct_um 5.33.
claims.note: Arithmetic reproduces (80 um, 5.33 um, 3.77 um per reading) and both sources match; the camera 15 um/px is an unmeasured assumption, which the claim itself says is on paper only.

claims.claim: Form 4 prints 31-80 mm features to +/-0.2 % (floor +/-0.06 mm), same size as the swelling signal, so strain must be measured on the same coupon before and after.
claims.note: The tolerance text is on the Formlabs page; the inference to paired measurement is sound arithmetic (0.2 % of 40 mm = 80 um).

claims.claim: Flexible 80A V2 data sheet gives +8 % mass and +3 % volume in deionized water after 1 day (ASTM D471 slab), contradicting the cube-table under-1 % claim.
claims.source_says: Rectangular slabs, used for hardness, mass, and volume change, are evaluated immediately after wiping dry without a conditioning period. (Row values recovered from scrambled layout: 1 day -26 +8% +3%.)
claims.note: Slab method is verbatim and the +8 %/+3 % row is recovered by coordinates between the Deionized Water label and the 1-week row, but the PDF text is scrambled so the row assignment is inferred; 'only material with large swelling' is unchecked.

overall: All four key claims reproduce against ISO 62, ASTM D570, the Travers and PA6.6 pages, the Formlabs Form 4 page and the project's calc output. The one caveat is the Flexible 80A V2 row, which depends on coordinate reconstruction of a scrambled PDF table. The camera resolution figure is an assumption, as the agent states.
